# Maximus Declares Quarterly Cash Dividend of $0.33 Per Share


October 05, 2026 6:30am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_877a9a45442aca0efcd12c5f0446f104/maximus/news/2026-10-05_Maximus_Declares_Quarterly_Cash_Dividend_of_0_33_589.pdf)


TYSONS, Va.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Maximus (NYSE: MMS), a leading provider of government services, announced today that its Board of Directors has approved a quarterly cash dividend of $0.33 per share, payable on November 30, 2026, to shareholders of record on November 13, 2026.


**About Maximus**


As a leading strategic partner to government, Maximus improves the delivery of public services amid complex technology, health, economic, and social challenges. Maximus provides tech-enabled services to government agencies, including innovative business process management and technology solutions, which improve outcomes for the public and create higher levels of productivity and efficiency of government-sponsored programs. With a deep understanding of program service delivery, acute insights that achieve operational excellence, and an extensive awareness of the needs of the people being served, our employees advance the critical missions of our partners. For more information, visit[maximus.com](http://www.maximus.com/) .
